title: IoT device data aggregation method based on continuous knowledge distillation and federated learning
assignee: Guangzhou Lianrong Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Data privacy and security issues, computing resource and bandwidth limitation issues, data heterogeneity and standardization issues, real-time and latency issues in IoT device data aggregation.
pse.solution_function: The method performs distributed training using federated learning to aggregate model updates from different devices. This results in a global optimization model, enhancing data privacy and security, reducing dependence on computing resources, handling diverse data formats, and meeting real-time requirements.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes IoT devices, a local model (on each device), a server for coordination and aggregation of updates, and a global model.
pse.solution_implementation: Each device trains its local model on locally collected data. The local model is periodically sent to the server where it gets distilled into the global model without sharing raw data. The global model is then sent back to each device for further updates.
pse.effect: Enhanced data privacy and security, reduced dependency on computing resources, handling of diverse data formats, meeting real-time requirements
